Package com.example.volt.selected

Class SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder

java.lang.Object
androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.ViewHolder
com.ernestoyaquello.dragdropswiperecyclerview.DragDropSwipeAdapter.ViewHolder
com.example.volt.selected.SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder
Enclosing class:
SelectedDestinationsAdapter
public static class SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder extends com.ernestoyaquello.dragdropswiperecyclerview.DragDropSwipeAdapter.ViewHolder
A SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder is a visual representation of a single element in the SelectedDestinationsAdapter's dataset.

Representation Invariant:

  • destinationItemConstraintLayout != null
  • destinationItemTextView != null
  • destinationItemDragHandleImageView != null

Abstraction Function:

SelectedDestinationsAdapter.ViewHolder vh represents a View that displays a single destination in the SelectedDestinationsAdapter's dataset such that:
  • vh.destinationItemConstraintLayout is a container for the entire item view
  • vh.destinationItemTextView displays destination's name
  • vh.destinationItemDragHandleImageView is a handle for dragging gesture
